w:r.w:t: Meeting minutes · Monday 5 October 2026, 4:00 PM · 1 h 10 min · Zoom

The team approved the library layout for build with two changes: rows stay at 68 px with status pills shown only for stages that have run, and the processing card hides whenever a filter or search is active.
The dark theme will ship with the first version rather than following later.
The empty state needs copy; Sam owns it.
Agree the library layout before build starts.
Sam opened with the 1440 px mockups and asked whether the row height felt tight.

Priya agreed that a pill on every row made the list busy. The proposal to show pills only for completed or running stages, and a quiet caption for audio-only recordings, was accepted without objection.
On the dark theme, Lee argued that Windows users switch themes with the system and a light-only first release would look unfinished; nobody disagreed.
Status pills only for stages that have run; audio-only shows a caption.
